invariants.rationale: The result of the execute method is expected to be a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object or at least users of this method likely expect a valid metadata result.
Since the HoodieWriteMetadata typically encapsulates write status information, it is likely expected that this collection is always initialized.
The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata parameterized with List<WriteStatus>, so the write statuses should always be a List at method exit.
